A. Meier’s 2001 Routledge edited volume. The actually consulted user-local PDF identifies Princeton University Press and David Roscoe’s translation on its title page, with C. P. Enz and M. Fierz assisting the editor and Beverley Zabriskie supplying the introduction. No copyright leaf was recovered; the exact Princeton printing and its equivalence to the selected Routledge edition remain uncollated. The P0 notebook is retained as authorial encounter and transcription provenance, distinct from the primary PDF. ## Chicago 18 forms **Full note:** C. G. Jung and Wolfgang Pauli, *Atom and Archetype: The Pauli/Jung Letters, 1932–1958*, ed. C. A. Meier (Routledge, 2001), {page}, https://www.routledge.com/Atom-and-Archetype-The-Pauli-Jung-Letters-1932-1958/Meier/p/book/9780415120784. **Shortened note:** Jung and Pauli, *Atom and Archetype*, {page}. **Bibliography:** Jung, C. Routledge, 2001. https://www.routledge.com/Atom-and-Archetype-The-Pauli-Jung-Letters-1932-1958/Meier/p/book/9780415120784. ## Essay use ### Source's relevant contribution - A historical witness to Jung and Pauli's attempts to think the relation of psyche, matter, archetype, and mathematical form without collapsing their disciplinary differences. ### Licensed essay use - Contextualise the §4 psychoid problem and qualify the claim that number can be treated as merely subjective convention or merely physical fact. - Preserve QL's arche-topos and numerical derivation as Taylor's argument; this correspondence neither derives nor verifies it. ### Claim boundary - “Psychoid,” “number,” and mirror imagery are historically specific concepts in the correspondence. Claims about computational consciousness, QL's relation to Jung and Pauli, or metaphysical identity require further arguments whose premises remain explicit. ## Consumption - **Stations:** §4/#0–#2; §5 only as a qualified historical bridge. - **Arguments:** [[Arche-Topos as Differential Field]]; [[Core Theorem Bridge]]; [[Agent Subjectivity Must Remain Open]]. - **Source relation:** contextualises and qualifies; never supplies the QL theorem. ## Quote and excerpt ledger The following are exact transcriptions from Frank's recoverable notebook, not yet checked against the selected 2001 edition. Their reported locators are provenance leads, not verified public quotations. | quote_id | exact text / excerpt file | locator | transcription | verification | consuming claim | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | `jung-pauli-meier-2001-q001` | “It is this number archetype that ultimately makes possible the application of mathematics in physics.” | P0 notebook, reported p. 107 | notebook-direct | `source-matched` | §4 psychoid number; [[Arche-Topos as Differential Field]] | | `jung-pauli-meier-2001-q002` | “they are as much inside as they are outside.” | P0 notebook, reported p. 127 | notebook-direct | `source-matched` | number as discovery/invention tension; [[Paradox as Cross-Register Hinge]] | | `jung-pauli-meier-2001-q003` | “Physis and Psyche are probably two aspects of one and the same abstract fact.” | P0 notebook, reported p. 159 | notebook-direct | `source-matched` | §4 psychoid problem; [[Arche-Topos as Differential Field]] | Full context, source boundaries, and additional page leads are in [[Source Extraction — Core Theorems and Epi Paper Write-ups#B. Jung–Pauli notebook extraction — psychoid number and mirror relation]]. ## Provenance and acquisition - **Metadata source:** Routledge publisher page, checked 2026-07-14. - **Excerpt carrier:** [[P0 - Jung and Pauli - Atom and Archetype]]. - **Text consulted:** selected primary contexts in the user-local Princeton-imprint PDF, 2026-09-08. Appendix 2 pp.176–178; Appendix 3 bearing passages pp.179–180,190,192–196; correspondence pp.34–42,99–120,125–129,157–160. Relevant diagrams and attribution pages were visually checked; physical page numbers are printed page numbers plus 62 in these spans. Full extraction served navigation and does not imply whole-book reading. - **Local copy:** `/Users/admin/Documents/Books/Pauli-Jung Letters - Atom and Archetype.pdf`; SHA-256 `c5974b22eaf031c89468c696058ab088651d93ae933de2988a0597ab38e8dbdc`. No sibling NOTES exists. - **Next action:** collate selected-edition wording before quotation promotion and identify the consulted Princeton printing. Speaker/date/context recoveries below discharge those contextual debts for their bounded spans only. The separate Taylor egg-specific commentary and historical duration of Pauli’s concern with 137 remain distinct retrieval tasks. ## Passages and excerpts The following stable passage cards admit contextual paraphrases from the consulted Princeton carrier. They contain no newly admitted verbatim quotation. The existing notebook q001–q003 transcriptions retain source-matched standing: p.107 is Pauli 60P, p.127 Jung 64J, p.159 Pauli 74P. The cards preserve Jung’s rejection of disciplinary absorption and Pauli’s criticism of ungrounded hyperspaces. The [Pauli egg whole](../../../../../mytheme/worlds/analytical-psychology/pauli-egg-dream/WHOLE.md) **figures** the seven-picture movement; the [Jung–Pauli dossier](../../../../dossiers/jung-pauli-psychoid.md) **historicises** the changing correspondence. These source returns do not ratify new QL identities or alter consumer claim standing. ### jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype-p001 — Appendix 3 §4 — seven-picture egg telling - **Locator:** Appendix 3, “Modern Examples of ‘Background Physics’,” §4, pp.192–193; Dream 2 - **Edition:** consulted Princeton-imprint PDF, David Roscoe translation; printing unverified; selected Routledge 2001 distinct. - **Source relation:** Paraphrased. - **Status:** paraphrase-verified; not quotation-ready. - **Verification:** direct scoped primary reading, 2026-09-08; prior visual checks reused only after PDF SHA-256 revalidation. - **Provenance:** user-local PDF identified above; contextual scopes and diagram/attribution checks retained in the Pauli egg and Jung–Pauli private packets. Picture 1: a woman arrives with a bird, which lays a large egg. Picture 2: the egg divides itself into two. Picture 3: Pauli approaches and notices another egg with a blue shell already in his hand. Picture 4: he divides it into two whole blue-shelled eggs. Picture 5: the four eggs become two identical rows of cosine and sine half-angle terms. Picture 6: the conjugate quotient (cos(δ/2)+i sin(δ/2))/(cos(δ/2)−i sin(δ/2)) appears. Picture 7: Pauli first speaks, identifies e^{iδ} and the circle; the formula vanishes and a circle appears. Seven pictures remain seven: arrival and laying are not separately numbered pictures. **Use boundary:** Visually checked diagrams at printed192–193; no hatching, shell repair, named bird/goddess, eighth scene or World Clock is supplied. ### jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype-p002 — Appendix 3 §4 — conscious participation and interpretive limit - **Locator:** Appendix 3 §4, pp.194–196; scope qualified by pp.179–180 and190 - **Edition:** consulted Princeton-imprint PDF, David Roscoe translation; printing unverified; selected Routledge 2001 distinct. - **Source relation:** Paraphrased. - **Status:** paraphrase-verified; not quotation-ready. - **Verification:** direct scoped primary reading, 2026-09-08; prior visual checks reused only after PDF SHA-256 revalidation. - **Provenance:** user-local PDF identified above; contextual scopes and diagram/attribution checks retained in the Pauli egg and Jung–Pauli private packets. Pauli reads the spontaneous pair as ground state and the dreamer’s recognition/action as conscious intervention producing quaternity through reflected duality. The quotient e^{iδ/2}/e^{−iδ/2}=e^{iδ} supplies the mathematical unity. He compares the Maria axiom through Jung while declining a finished interpretation. Physical frequency/mass is not a direct consciousness measure, and the limits of physics within life are distinct from a defect of quantum theory within physics. **Use boundary:** The primary psychological commentary remains available without treating it as a physical theory or a QL derivation. Maria’s ancient attribution is mediated through Jung here, not independently collated. ### jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype-p003 — JP-P01 — correspondence context - **Locator:** 35P; Zollikon-Zürich, 7 November 1948; pp.34–35 - **Edition:** consulted Princeton-imprint PDF, David Roscoe translation; printing unverified; selected Routledge 2001 distinct. - **Source relation:** Paraphrased. - **Status:** paraphrase-verified; not quotation-ready. - **Verification:** direct scoped primary reading, 2026-09-08; prior visual checks reused only after PDF SHA-256 revalidation. - **Provenance:** user-local PDF identified above; contextual scopes and diagram/attribution checks retained in the Pauli egg and Jung–Pauli private packets. Pauli questions calling a two- or three-month separation synchronous. His connected-sheet rotation is a symbolic ordering image, not a demonstrated physical topology. **Use boundary:** Historical attribution and contextual paraphrase only; selected-edition verbatim wording remains uncollated. ### jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype-p004 — JP-P02 — correspondence context - **Locator:** 37P; 28 June 1949; pp.36–42 - **Edition:** consulted Princeton-imprint PDF, David Roscoe translation; printing unverified; selected Routledge 2001 distinct. - **Source relation:** Paraphrased. - **Status:** paraphrase-verified; not quotation-ready. - **Verification:** direct scoped primary reading, 2026-09-08; prior visual checks reused only after PDF SHA-256 revalidation. - **Provenance:** user-local PDF identified above; contextual scopes and diagram/attribution checks retained in the Pauli egg and Jung–Pauli private packets. Pauli distinguishes Rhine material from archetypal cases, causality from ordering, and simultaneity from prediction. His radioactive-stranger parable seeks a neutral language not yet available; it is not experimental confirmation. **Use boundary:** Historical attribution and contextual paraphrase only; selected-edition verbatim wording remains uncollated. ### jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype-p005 — JP-P03 — correspondence context - **Locator:** 60P; Zürich, 31 March 1953; pp.102–107, especially 105–107 - **Edition:** consulted Princeton-imprint PDF, David Roscoe translation; printing unverified; selected Routledge 2001 distinct. - **Source relation:** Paraphrased. - **Status:** paraphrase-verified; not quotation-ready. - **Verification:** direct scoped primary reading, 2026-09-08; prior visual checks reused only after PDF SHA-256 revalidation. - **Provenance:** user-local PDF identified above; contextual scopes and diagram/attribution checks retained in the Pauli egg and Jung–Pauli private packets. Pauli resists calling the whole ordering field psychic. Homo-usia is a working hypothesis; mathematical objects remain distinct from the psychic experience of mathematics. **Use boundary:** Historical attribution and contextual paraphrase only; selected-edition verbatim wording remains uncollated. ### jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype-p006 — JP-P04 — correspondence context - **Locator:** 60P; p.107 and footnote 9; editorial Appendix 3 reference p.111 - **Edition:** consulted Princeton-imprint PDF, David Roscoe translation; printing unverified; selected Routledge 2001 distinct. - **Source relation:** Paraphrased. - **Status:** paraphrase-verified; not quotation-ready. - **Verification:** direct scoped primary reading, 2026-09-08; prior visual checks reused only after PDF SHA-256 revalidation. - **Provenance:** user-local PDF identified above; contextual scopes and diagram/attribution checks retained in the Pauli egg and Jung–Pauli private packets. Pauli identifies the first dream as 1948, the background-physics essay as June 1948, and a following quaternity dream. Appendix 3 §4 pp.192–196 supplies the four-day mid-March interval. This retrospective witness supplements Fierz’s undated-typescript description. Exact egg day/place remain unsupplied. **Use boundary:** Historical attribution and contextual paraphrase only; selected-edition verbatim wording remains uncollated. ### jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype-p007 — JP-P05 — correspondence context - **Locator:** 60P; pp.108–110 - **Edition:** consulted Princeton-imprint PDF, David Roscoe translation; printing unverified; selected Routledge 2001 distinct. - **Source relation:** Paraphrased. - **Status:** paraphrase-verified; not quotation-ready. - **Verification:** direct scoped primary reading, 2026-09-08; prior visual checks reused only after PDF SHA-256 revalidation. - **Provenance:** user-local PDF identified above; contextual scopes and diagram/attribution checks retained in the Pauli egg and Jung–Pauli private packets. Pauli compares physical, theological-metaphysical and psychological languages. Dream numbers have particular figures beyond scalar quantity. His three-rings interpretation locates unity in human relation and an empty centre. **Use boundary:** Historical attribution and contextual paraphrase only; selected-edition verbatim wording remains uncollated. ### jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype-p008 — JP-P06 — correspondence context - **Locator:** 61J; Zürich, 4 May 1953; pp.111–117 - **Edition:** consulted Princeton-imprint PDF, David Roscoe translation; printing unverified; selected Routledge 2001 distinct. - **Source relation:** Paraphrased. - **Status:** paraphrase-verified; not quotation-ready. - **Verification:** direct scoped primary reading, 2026-09-08; prior visual checks reused only after PDF SHA-256 revalidation. - **Provenance:** user-local PDF identified above; contextual scopes and diagram/attribution checks retained in the Pauli egg and Jung–Pauli private packets. Jung describes psychoid as a speculative approach toward nonpsychic essence, distinguishes knowing psychically from absorbing an object into psychic substance, and disputes professional language as sufficient dream interpretation. **Use boundary:** Historical attribution and contextual paraphrase only; selected-edition verbatim wording remains uncollated. ### jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype-p009 — JP-P07 — correspondence context - **Locator:** 62P; Zürich, 27 May 1953; pp.117–120, especially 118–119 - **Edition:** consulted Princeton-imprint PDF, David Roscoe translation; printing unverified; selected Routledge 2001 distinct. - **Source relation:** Paraphrased. - **Status:** paraphrase-verified; not quotation-ready. - **Verification:** direct scoped primary reading, 2026-09-08; prior visual checks reused only after PDF SHA-256 revalidation. - **Provenance:** user-local PDF identified above; contextual scopes and diagram/attribution checks retained in the Pauli egg and Jung–Pauli private packets. Pauli says the physical dream terms initially felt strange. His proposed enlarged physics adopting psychology requires the adopter’s greater transformation; this is his proposal, not a shared consensus. **Use boundary:** Historical attribution and contextual paraphrase only; selected-edition verbatim wording remains uncollated. ### jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype-p010 — JP-P08 — correspondence context - **Locator:** 64J; Küsnacht-Zürich, 24 October 1953; pp.125–129, especially 127–128 - **Edition:** consulted Princeton-imprint PDF, David Roscoe translation; printing unverified; selected Routledge 2001 distinct. - **Source relation:** Paraphrased. - **Status:** paraphrase-verified; not quotation-ready. - **Verification:** direct scoped primary reading, 2026-09-08; prior visual checks reused only after PDF SHA-256 revalidation. - **Provenance:** user-local PDF identified above; contextual scopes and diagram/attribution checks retained in the Pauli egg and Jung–Pauli private packets. Jung treats numbers as inward forms and outward quantities at p.127, then rejects absorbing psychology into physics on the chemistry model at p.128. Number and synchronicity remain proposed points of contact. **Use boundary:** Historical attribution and contextual paraphrase only; selected-edition verbatim wording remains uncollated. ### jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype-p011 — JP-P09 — correspondence context - **Locator:** 74P; Zürich, June 1957; pp.158–159 - **Edition:** consulted Princeton-imprint PDF, David Roscoe translation; printing unverified; selected Routledge 2001 distinct. - **Source relation:** Paraphrased. - **Status:** paraphrase-verified; not quotation-ready. - **Verification:** direct scoped primary reading, 2026-09-08; prior visual checks reused only after PDF SHA-256 revalidation. - **Provenance:** user-local PDF identified above; contextual scopes and diagram/attribution checks retained in the Pauli egg and Jung–Pauli private packets. Pauli’s tentative mirror-image conjecture occurs while criticising W. M. van Dusen’s Mind in Hyperspace. He distinguishes metric/topological structure and challenges ungrounded dimension counts. The psychological conjectures remain Pauli’s, not an adopted diagnosis. **Use boundary:** Historical attribution and contextual paraphrase only; selected-edition verbatim wording remains uncollated.
